messages:
Maya: saw a weird pattern this morning: customers getting resumed but routed to a different shard and charged twice.
Ben: I caught that too. traces show resume accepted but quota service sees two distinct sessions.
Iris: could be the routing policy returning a different "route-id" when resume header is present vs absent. any repro?
Maya: repro steps: open WS -> force kill -> client posts resume within 4s with X-Resume-Key. server 204, but proxy retry path sometimes strips header -> new route -> new auth = new charge.
Ben: logs (sanitized):
```
Client -> POST /v1/ws/resume
  X-Resume-Key: rkey-77
Proxy(retry) -> POST /v1/ws/resume   # header missing here
Runtime -> 204 resume accepted
Quota -> increment session_tokens for token-id-abc
Quota -> increment session_tokens for token-id-xyz
```
Iris: aha proxy rebuilds request for the retry and only preserves a whitelist of headers. resume header not in it.
RouterBot: rollout note: routing-sticky v3 was bumped yesterday to reduce shard hotspots; sticky TTL changed to 10s in canary.
Maya: TTL mismatch + header loss = higher chance of shard flip during short resumes.
Ben: short-term: add X-Resume-Key to proxy header whitelist and bump sticky TTL to 30s for canary.
Iris: medium-term: attach resume-fingerprint to quota events so we can dedupe charges when resume-fingerprint matches within 20s. add a flag resume_quota_dedupe.
ConsoleUI: also request: dashboard card comparing "resume_requests" vs "new_session_creates" by client_id so SREs can spot delta.
Maya: agree. I'll add alert: (new_session_creates / resume_requests) > 1.05 for 5m.
Ben: i'll draft the proxy PR and can roll to 5% canary. Iris, please spec quota dedupe API + migration.
Iris: will do. include e2e that kills socket and asserts single quota increment. also add unit test for header whitelist.
Maya: thanks — assign Ben -> proxy change, Iris -> quota & tests, ConsoleUI -> dashboard. follow up in 12h. :thumbsup:
